author: The Current
description:
From a 2007 interview, Glen Hansard talks about meeting Bob Dylan in Dublin
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

In 2007, the late Glen Hansard visited The Current with his band, The Frames. During the interview portion of the studio session, Hansard shared a story about his random-chance meeting of Bob Dylan at a rehearsal space in Dublin. "I went home, I told my mother," Hansard says. "She couldn't believe it!"

Hansard, the Irish singer who won an Oscar for the musical movie "Once" and the led the bands The Frames and The Swell Season, died on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, in a motorcycle crash in Dublin. He was 56 years old.
